title: Organization settings
intro: Manage visual identity, languages, staff, and internal documents.
logoHelp: JPG, PNG, or WebP. Maximum 1 MB.
contrastHelp: Colors are accepted when their text meets WCAG AA contrast.
languageLocked: Because of the grant obligation, Catalan must remain enabled and the default for Ramassà.
actionError: The action could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
removeConfirm: Confirm that you want to remove access and revoke every session for this person.
documentsIntro: A private area for insurance, inventory, and organization resources. Only staff and administrators can access it.
documentHelp: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, DOC, or DOCX. Maximum 10 MB.
fundingNotice: The Generalitat funding acknowledgment is mandatory and cannot be removed in these settings.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Invite people, choose what each person may do, and remove access. The organization always keeps at least one person with Team management.
team.presetsIntro: A preset sets up a person quickly. Changing a preset changes nobody until you choose to apply it.
team.errorLastManager: At least one active person must keep Team management. Give it to someone else first.
team.errorNotHeld: You can only change permissions that you hold yourself.
team.errorBuiltIn: A built-in preset cannot be deleted. You can restore its default instead.
team.editAccessIntro: Start from a preset, then turn single permissions on or off.
team.editPresetIntro: Choose the permissions people get when this preset is applied.
team.applyTitle_one: Apply the changes to the {{count}} person who uses {{preset}}?
team.applyTitle_other: Apply the changes to the {{count}} people who use {{preset}}?
team.applyIntro: Their access changes only if you apply it here. The audit log records each change.

apply.nobody: No, keep their access as it is

team.lockedHint: You can only change permissions that you hold yourself. The others are shown but locked.

participants_view.label: See participants
participants_view.description: The participant list and the Basic fields: name, photo, language, referring entity, sizes, sign-ups and attendance.

participants_view_personal.label: See personal details
participants_view_personal.description: Also date and place of birth, nationality, city, document type, dependants and the contact at the referring entity.

participants_view_sensitive.label: See sensitive details
participants_view_sensitive.description: Also the four encrypted fields: address, postal code, phone and document number.

participants_notes.label: Team notes
participants_notes.description: Read and write the team's internal notes on a participant.

participants_deactivate.label: Deactivate accounts
participants_deactivate.description: Deactivate and reactivate a player's account.

rgpd_erase.label: RGPD erasure
rgpd_erase.description: Handle deletion requests and erase a player's data. Permanent deletion also needs Team management.

equipment_handover.label: Hand over material
equipment_handover.description: Record a handover to a player and see the handover history.

equipment_receive.label: Receive material
equipment_receive.description: Record material that arrives at the storeroom.

equipment_count.label: Count stock
equipment_count.description: Correct the stock counts after a count.

equipment_items.label: Manage the item list
equipment_items.description: Add and edit the types of material and their sizes.

attendance_mark.label: Take attendance
attendance_mark.description: Take attendance for a session, online or offline.

attendance_reports.label: Attendance reports
attendance_reports.description: See attendance per event and per participant.

announcements_edit.label: Edit announcements
announcements_edit.description: Create and change announcement drafts and translations.

announcements_publish.label: Publish announcements
announcements_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete announcements.

events_edit.label: Edit events
events_edit.description: Create and change events, trainings, recurring sessions and event categories.

events_publish.label: Publish events
events_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete events.

knowledge_edit.label: Edit knowledge base
knowledge_edit.description: Create and change articles, and review story submissions.

knowledge_publish.label: Publish knowledge base
knowledge_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete articles and stories.

services_edit.label: Edit services
services_edit.description: Create and change services in the directory and their categories.

services_publish.label: Publish services
services_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete services.

services_review.label: Review entity services
services_review.description: Approve or reject the services partner entities submit.

forum_moderate.label: Moderate the forum
forum_moderate.description: Handle reports, hide and restore posts, and ban players from posting.

gallery_moderate.label: Moderate the gallery
gallery_moderate.description: Approve, hide and remove gallery photos.

messages_inbox.label: Team inbox
messages_inbox.description: Read and answer the conversations between the team and players or entities.

mentoring_manage.label: Mentoring
mentoring_manage.description: See mentoring requests, including their private topic, and write the team's notes.

feedback_view.label: Read feedback
feedback_view.description: Read the private feedback players send.

surveys_manage.label: Manage surveys
surveys_manage.description: Create, publish and close surveys and polls.

notifications_send.label: Send notifications
notifications_send.description: Send push notifications to players and manage the templates.

referrals_manage.label: Referrals
referrals_manage.description: See and update referrals from entities, including the referred person's phone, notes and updates.

entities_manage.label: Partner entities
entities_manage.description: Add and edit partner entities, their collaborators and invitations.

impact_view.label: Impact dashboard
impact_view.description: See the impact dashboard and make impact reports for funders.

export_participants.label: Export participants
export_participants.description: Export the participant list without the four sensitive fields.

export_participants_sensitive.label: Export with sensitive details
export_participants_sensitive.description: Export the participant list with the four sensitive fields. Also needs See sensitive details.

audit_view.label: Audit log
audit_view.description: See who saw, changed or exported what, and when.

settings_organization.label: Organization details
settings_organization.description: Edit the name, contact details and languages.

settings_documents.label: Internal documents
settings_documents.description: Manage internal documents such as insurance forms and inventories.

team_manage.label: Team management
team_manage.description: Add and remove team members, edit presets and toggles, and reset a lost second factor.

handoff.title: Take the photo with your phone
handoff.scan: Scan this code with your phone's camera. On the phone, sign in as yourself.
handoff.done: The photo arrived. It is in the documents list.
handoff.expired: The code expired. Show a new one.
handoff.failed: The code could not be made. Try again.
handoff.qrLabel: Code to scan with the phone
handoff.sent: Sent. The photo is on the computer now. You can close this.
handoff.pageExpired: This code has expired. Ask the computer for a new one.
handoff.notFound: This code is not for this account. Sign in as the person who made it.
handoff.sendFailed: The photo was not sent. Try again.
handoff.cameraDenied: Allow the camera in Settings to take a photo.

contrastTooLow: This colour has {{ratio}}:1 contrast with its text. It needs at least 4.5:1.
colorInvalid: Use a six-digit hex colour such as #0077B6.
